title: Record scoped engineering judgments and their basis
description: Retains an accountable engineering conclusion together with its exact claim scope, evidence basis, reasoning, and limitations. It distinguishes recorded semantic judgment from mechanical coverage, accepted tradeoffs, and execution authority.
inputs: Proposed judgment, accountable participant or source, reasoning, exact subject state, and claim criteria and scope.
Applicable evidence, criterion coverage, contradiction dispositions, and unresolved gaps.
preconditions: The proposed conclusion and its scope are identifiable.
outputs: Recorded engineering judgment with its supporting basis, limitations, and accountable source.
Explicit unestablished or narrower supported scope where the evidence does not justify the full claim.
behavior: Retain the conclusion, judging participant or accountable source, reasoning, exact claim basis, and references to supporting and contrary evidence.
Do not present full satisfaction as established when required criterion support is missing or a material contradiction remains unresolved.
Allow a narrower supported conclusion only with explicit included and excluded scope; distinguish an accepted exception or tradeoff from observed satisfaction.
After reassessment, record the new judgment against its new basis while keeping earlier conclusions attributable to their historical state.
Keep permission to execute governed actions outside the judgment and do not convert mechanical coverage into an unstated semantic conclusion.

failure_behavior.condition: A proposed satisfaction conclusion exceeds evidence scope or conceals an unresolved gap or contradiction.
failure_behavior.outcome: Identify the inconsistency and leave the affected claim unestablished rather than recording unsupported satisfaction as current truth.

failure_behavior.condition: The judgment lacks accountable provenance or reasoning.
failure_behavior.outcome: Expose the incomplete judgment basis without supplying an invented engineering decision.

failure_behavior.condition: A conclusion is offered as authorization for a governed action.
failure_behavior.outcome: Keep the conclusion separate from the applicable authority requirement.

unallocated_reason: Architectural responsibility is deliberately deferred until the logical requirements and system design are reconciled. This Function establishes behavior, not a Module, Interface, implementation, or verification result.

sources.basis: SR-028 and SR-029 confirm scoped judgment and preserved reassessment history under IR-004. SR-007 independently owns execution authority.
